policy: All AI visuals are illustrative historical reconstructions or folklore illustrations, not documentary photographs or evidence of supernatural events. Do not depict a body, injury, blood, violence, identifiable victim, real witness, ghost, or supernatural evidence. Do not invent readable headlines, newspaper text, logos, signage, or exact architectural details. Former Taman Festival is represented as a historical reconstruction, not present-day footage. Preserve a respectful, investigative documentary tone. Renderer overlays REKA ADEGAN • ILUSTRASI AI. Match the EP02 Balinese Gothic Documentary master style.

art_direction.name: Balinese Gothic Documentary • Etching + Charcoal + Dark Oil Painting

art_direction.cultural_respect: Balinese architecture and cultural objects must be depicted respectfully and contextually. Do not use poleng cloth, masks, offerings, shrines, or sacred figures as shorthand for evil. No invented ritual scenes or sacred iconography used as horror props.
art_direction.allocation: 2 engraving/etching scenes, 2 charcoal scenes, 2 dark gothic oil painting scenes
